subject: Re: rqtl: parallels package not available?

messages.author: 963b6d84a823404f
messages.subject: Re: rqtl: parallels package not available?
parts:
The parallel package is distributed with R; you don't need to download it separately.

The message "Loading required package: parallel" is not really a warning message. It's just saying that it has loaded the parallel package. Everything should function the same way.

karl

>
> I recently dusted off RQTL in an attempt to move towards open source software. I also decided it was a good time to upgrade to the latest version of R (3.0.2, "Frisbee Sailing" running on Mac OS 10.7.5). After installing the rqtl package, I tried to load the library but was greeted with an warning message - the package parallel is apparently not available in the current version of R. As you can see below, I managed to get RQTL to run, but not without some additional unexpected warning messages (or at least warning messages that are not mentioned in your book, "A Guide to QTL Mapping with R/qtl", ) when importing sample datasets. Is this warning message normal? Do I need to downgrade to a previous version of R for the qtl package to function (if so, which version)? Or can this error message be ignored? (the summary statistics and plots look identical to those in the book).
>
